power.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.desc: Illusions, crushing spiritual pressure, the strongest Kido and the Hogyoku's evolution.
power.battlegroundsmod.rubber_boy.desc: A rubber body that stretches as far as it needs.
power.battlegroundsmod.one_punch.desc: Trained so hard that any punch is the last one.

message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_blocke: No room in front of the target
screen.battlegroundsmod.skills.title: Abilities
ability.battlegroundsmod.destruction_god: Hold to charge a ringed energy sphere over your hand. Let go to throw it homing at the target; with no target it follows your aim until it finds someone and blows up everything around.
Freezes the target, flicks it up into the air, vanishes and reappears behind it for a slap that drives it back into the ground.

Point at the target and hold to keep a tiny sphere of destruction at your finger. Let go: it flies straight along your aim, implodes into a giant sun and keeps going until it hits. The explosion rises in smoke, rewinds and blows up again with a shockwave.
Erases from existence anyone under 20% health. Above that, summons a Hakai ball that chases the target, traps it and explodes.
Rises into the sky and drops a tiny white ball. The ground cracks into lava and bursts into plasma, pulverizing everything in a colossal radius.
Rises into the air, intangible, and fires a rain of energy spheres from the whole body at the target, then glides down. A strong stun cancels it.

Takes the target to space, where it drifts helplessly while Bills charges a sphere of destruction between his hands and throws it. The sphere carries the target back down to Earth from high in the sky and blows up in flames on impact.
A tiny spark that flies straight and pulverizes everything it touches, even other powers' attacks. Anyone under 20% health is disintegrated.
Breathes a stream of fire, burning and slowing everyone in the cone.
The Mangekyo eyes catch whoever is in front: stuns, blinds and seals the target's abilities for a few seconds.
Stands guard for a moment. Whoever strikes is grabbed by the Susanoo's arm, crushed and thrown.
Calls a giant meteor that tears through the clouds and falls on the target.
Rushes the target and grabs it by the neck in a cinematic strike.
Jumps, stops in the air and charges a fireball that grows while the key is held. Let go to throw it.
Records the next 30 seconds around you. Then rewrites fate: everything goes back to the start and whoever died is left a ghost.
The Susanoo's sword cuts a huge line ahead, splitting blocks and enemies.
Two meteors fall one after the other on the target.
gamerule.soulsBlockDestruction.descripti: When off, no skill or boss from the mod breaks or changes blocks. Effects and damage stay. mobGriefing off also stops it.
gamerule.soulbossfight.description: On: bosses have entrance and phase titles, boss bar, phases and the final ult. Off: they are plain mobs using all their moves from the start.
power.battlegroundsmod.strongest.desc: Throughout heaven and earth, he alone is the honored one.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.0.des: Tap: a blue orb flies to where you aim, locks there and pulls enemies in for 6 s. Hold: it grows up to 5x in your hands and leaves only when you let go; then it follows your aim for 10 s (lagging slightly), pulling hard and tearing blocks out. While it is out, the mouse wheel sends it away (up to 70 blocks) or closer (down to 10); tap Z to park or unpark it; hold Z while it follows to shoot it so it explodes; hold Z while it is parked to make it circle you on its own (15 blocks) until it ends. Charged 50% or more, if it touches the ground its middle turns into a singularity that eats the blocks around it away (up to 10 blocks, faster the closer).
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.1.des: Repulsion: the red orb lights up at his fingertip and bursts into a wall of force straight where you aim, carving a cylindrical tunnel through ground and walls and throwing whoever is in it far away. Tap: the normal shot. Hold: it charges (past 50% its tails form) and fires only when you let go, much longer and wider.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.2.des: Hold C: the Red and the Blue appear behind you, come round to the front of your chest and slowly mix into the Purple (5 s). Keep holding: it grows up to 4x. Let go: it is launched straight where you aim, speeding up, and erases everything in its path (blocks and targets). Let go before it formed: it finishes forming and leaves at its base size. Unlimited Purple: park a fully charged Blue and hit it with a fully charged Red: both implode into a giant Purple that blows up in every direction over 100 blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.3.des: Makes the hand sign and expands the domain: a black sphere swallows everything around. Inside there is only the void, and whoever is caught gets infinite information, paralyzed until the domain breaks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.5.des: Hold out your hand: the Blue grabs the target you aim at (up to 50 blocks) and pulls it flying to you. Close to you time slows down and your fist cocks back crackling with black lightning. Always a Black Flash: the punch lands and holds, the target stuck on your fist while waves of black lightning burst out and open a crater at the punch point, and only then it is thrown far. Hold the key from the start to charge it.
message.battlegroundsmod.azul_flash_no_t: Aim at someone to pull them with the Blue.
message.battlegroundsmod.vermelho_no_tar: Aim at someone to appear behind them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.strongest.6.des: Appears behind the target you aim at, floating upside down, raises the finger and fires the Red point blank.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.0.d: Hold to raise a box of black light around the target that grows while held. Let go and it shuts, lances pierce everyone inside and it shatters. With the Hogyoku active it is the full incantation: bigger and stronger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.1.d: A clone of you stays in place while you turn invisible to everyone else and walk free for up to 7 seconds. Mobs go after the clone. Press again (or hit the clone) and it breaks like a mirror, and you show up wherever you are.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.2.d: Tap: a small pulse that drops whoever is near. Hold: the pressure grows to a huge radius, crushing everyone to the ground (no attacks, barely moving). Let go and it bursts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.3.d: The Hogyoku lights up in your chest and a white cocoon closes around you (nothing can hurt you). It cracks and bursts, throwing everyone away, and you come out with six black butterfly wings: stronger, faster, the Black Box becomes the full incantation, and pressing V again does the dash of cuts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.4.d: Raise one finger for half a second. Anyone who hits you in that time is stopped dead on it, time freezes and you draw the sword and cut back.
ability.battlegroundsmod.manipulator.6.d: A beam of white lightning that pierces everything in your aim.
message.battlegroundsmod.hogyoku: Hogyoku Evolution: press V again for the dash of cuts
message.battlegroundsmod.stamina_out: Out of stamina! Vulnerable for %s s
message.battlegroundsmod.needs_stun: The target must be stunned (hit it with a stun or drain its stamina).
message.battlegroundsmod.domain_resist: Infinite information! Your stamina is holding off the Domain...
message.battlegroundsmod.technique_burno: Burnt-out technique: no techniques for %s s
power.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Controlled blades: a thousand petals that cut whatever he wants.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.0.desc: The blade becomes a river of petal-blades that follows your aim while held and comes back when let go. Right next to you it doesn't cut.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.1.desc: Hold aiming at a target: the petals close into a sphere around it and squeeze. Let go and they crush it from every side.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.2.desc: Flash step behind the target and two quick cuts that lock it for a moment.
ability.battlegroundsmod.byakuya.3.desc: Two rows of giant blades rise around you and come apart into a storm of petals that follows you for 20 seconds.
power.battlegroundsmod.rukia.desc: Low Soul from Bleach. Zones of ice.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.0.desc: A white circle where you aim; a column of ice rises and everything inside turns into an ice statue.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.1.desc: A wide white avalanche forward that freezes everything in its way.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.2.desc: The blade stretches into ice at once and pierces far; the ice spreads from the wound.
ability.battlegroundsmod.rukia.3.desc: You freeze over and turn white; absolute zero spreads around you and turns everyone close into crystal.
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip1: Eat it once: you never go hungry again
item.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.tip2: But hunger stays below the point that regenerates health (permanent passive)
message.battlegroundsmod.teleport_domain: Can't teleport into or out of a Domain Expansion
message.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.eat: The Soul Insect lives in you now: you will never go hungry again
message.battlegroundsmod.soul_insect.alr: Your soul already carries a Soul Insect
advancements.battlegroundsmod.soul_insec: Eat a Soul Insect and never go hungry again
power.battlegroundsmod.goku.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Pure ki: beams, teleport and the Kaioken, always past the limit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.0.desc: Hold with cupped hands: the blue ball grows. Let go and the beam comes out; keep holding and it thickens, pushes the target and explodes at the end. With the Kaioken it comes out red and 2x bigger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.1.desc: Fingers on the forehead for a moment: you vanish and appear behind the aimed target, already punching.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.2.desc: Red aura: punches 50% stronger and 1.5x faster, but your life drains (it never kills). Press again while it is on: a red blur of 4 hits and a launching kick.
ability.battlegroundsmod.goku.3.desc: Hands to the sky: the light of everything around gathers in a huge sphere. Hold up to 60 s (full, it kills in one hit) and let go: it falls slowly and leaves a crater.
power.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). The proud prince: endless barrages and the Final Flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.0.desc: Hold: ki shots fly from both hands nonstop. The smoke piles up on the target and blinds it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.1.desc: The open palm forms a big ball of ki waves that flies straight and bursts into tongues of energy.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.2.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
ability.battlegroundsmod.vegeta.3.desc: Arms open gathering golden energy (you stand still and exposed), then the hands join and a giant beam goes through everything and tears the ground.
power.battlegroundsmod.freeza.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 6 (Continental). Elegant cruelty: piercing fingers, telekinesis and the Death Ball.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.0.desc: Point and hold: thin pink rays come from the finger, up to 6 in a row, piercing everyone in line.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.1.desc: Lifts the target and holds it (no skills). Press again: slams it into the ground, leaving a crater.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.2.desc: A pink saw disc grows on the finger and chases the target, turns and comes back, cutting you too if you don't dodge. Press again to pop it in the air.
ability.battlegroundsmod.freeza.3.desc: An energy sphere grows on the raised finger until it is huge and falls slowly, exploding in a supernova.
power.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The strategist: a ray that pierces everything, a stretching arm and ki traps.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.0.desc: Hold with two fingers on the forehead, crackling. Let go: a thin ray with two spirals pierces everyone in line (more charge, more damage).
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.1.desc: The arm stretches 8 blocks, grabs the target and pulls it straight into a launching knee.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.2.desc: Ki balls that seem to miss stop in the air around the target (touching one hurts). Press again and they all close on it at once.
ability.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.kame.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 7 (City). The old master: looks weak and silly, but wears anyone out.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.0.desc: 4 s staggering: every melee hit has a 60% chance to slip past, and you slap back a crooked palm. Press again: the palm right away.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.1.desc: You swell: body 1.4x bigger, shirt bursting, punches +40% for 8 s. Press again: the original, huge Kamehameha, and you are skinny again.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.2.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kame.3.desc: A green gale pulls the target into a spiral and the tornado narrows into the jar. Sealed 8 s (boss 4 s): at 20% life or less it dies sealed; with more, it breaks the jar and comes out with 15% less. Then you are on your knees with no stamina.
power.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.desc: Low Soul from Dragon Ball, Tier 8 (Block). The weakest of the group, but the smartest: discs that cut everything and a blinding flash.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.0.desc: A yellow saw disc grows over the raised hand and flies flat, cutting whoever it hits (very high damage) and the blocks on its way. Easy to dodge. Hold until it forms: two discs.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.1.desc: A white flash from the head blinds whoever was looking at you: stunned 6 s, white screen, mobs lose their target. A hit FROM THE FRONT wakes them at once; from behind, it doesn't.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.2.desc: A ki ball shoots up over the aimed spot and splits into ~30 rays that rain on the whole area.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
message.battlegroundsmod.db.skill_coming: This skill is still being made in the Visualizer. Coming in a next version!
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.tele_no_ta: Instant Transmission: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.kaioken_li: Kaioken: the body hit its limit and it switched off.
message.battlegroundsmod.goku.rush_no_ta: Kaioken rush: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.freeza.tele_no_: Telekinesis: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.piccolo.hellzon: Hellzone Grenade: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.palm_no_ta: Palm: nobody close in front of you.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.mafuba_no_: Mafuba: aim at someone within %s blocks.
message.battlegroundsmod.kame.sealed: You were sealed in the Mafuba jar!
message.battlegroundsmod.kuririn.taiyoke: Solar Flare: nobody was looking at you.
power.battlegroundsmod.naruto.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Loud and stubborn: clones everywhere, a Rasengan to the face and Sage Mode.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.0.desc: The chakra sphere forms in your palm, you run up to 7 blocks and drive it into the target: it grinds for half a second and launches them spinning like a drill. With clones alive it becomes the Oodama Rasengan (twice as big).
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.1.desc: Cross seal: three clones with 1 health appear in smoke and fight on their own. Press again: swap places with the clone closest to the target and punch from behind.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.2.desc: Four clones appear around the target and kick it up (U, ZU, MA, KI); you jump over it and come down heel first, slamming it into the ground.
ability.battlegroundsmod.naruto.3.desc: You sit and meditate for 4 s (a hit breaks it). For 30 s every punch reaches 2 blocks farther and hits harder (Kawazu Kumite). Press again: the Rasenshuriken, thrown; at the target it becomes a giant sphere of wind needles that tears up the ground.
power.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 6 (Continental). Cold and precise: reads the enemy's attack, paralyzes and runs them through with the Chidori.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.0.desc: Hold: your hand becomes a chirping bundle of lightning scratching the ground; the longer you hold, the farther you go (4 to 9 blocks). Release: a straight dash through the target. A paralyzed target can't escape: you home in for a critical hit.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.1.desc: A 1 s reading stance. If you're hit in that window (punch or shot), you read it: no damage, an afterimage stays behind and you appear behind the attacker with a spinning kick.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.2.desc: A fan of 9 lightning needles (60°). Whoever takes 2 or more is paralyzed for 2 s, sparks crawling over them.
ability.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.3.desc: Storm clouds gather over the target; you raise your hand and a dragon of lightning comes down on it. It can't be dodged (it follows the target). Open sky only.
power.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 7 (City). The ninja who copied a thousand techniques: a lightning hound, Kamui and the copying Sharingan.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.0.desc: The Raikiri in your hand becomes a hound of lightning when you drive the hand into the ground. It runs along the ground, follows the target even if it dodges (up to 14 blocks) and bites: damage and 1 s of paralysis.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.1.desc: The Mangekyo turns and the space around the target twists into a spiral: it is pulled into another dimension and is out of the fight for 4 s (can't hit, can't be hit), then spat back out, hurt. Your sight blurs for 2 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.2.desc: The last skill ANYONE used near you in the last 10 s (a Soul, a Low Soul or a boss) you use once, 20% stronger. A Divine Soul's ult can't be copied.
ability.battlegroundsmod.kakashi.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.gaara.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 7 (City). Real sand: it guards you on its own, grabs, crushes and carries you through the air.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.0.desc: The sand rises from the ground into a giant hand that tips over and slaps the target about 6 blocks away. Hold: the hand closes on the target and starts the Coffin. Passive, Sand Shield: the first hit or shot from the front every 6 s sticks in a wall of sand.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.1.desc: The sand runs along the ground to the target and swallows its whole body in a shell: held for 3 s, no walking, no skills. Press again: Sand Burial, the sand squeezes all at once and bursts.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.2.desc: The sand gathers under your feet and lifts you about 3 blocks; you fly where you aim for up to 10 s (Z and X still work up there). Press again: you go down and the platform crumbles.
ability.battlegroundsmod.gaara.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 8 (Block). Lazy and brilliant: pins with his shadow, stitches enemies and walks them into checkmate.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.0.des: Your shadow runs along the ground to the target (up to 12 blocks) and catches it: it copies every step you take. Press again: Shadow Strangle, the shadow climbs into a hand on the neck: damage while you hold the key, costing stamina.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.1.des: The shadow splits toward up to 3 enemies and rises in sharp threads that pierce them and pin them for 1.5 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.2.des: A kunai with a paper bomb stuck in the ground (2 at most); it goes off when an enemy steps on it. With two armed, press again to set both off. Walk a possessed target onto one: checkmate.
ability.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.3.des: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.ino.desc: Low Soul from Naruto, Tier 8 (Block). The mind is the weapon: she takes over enemies' bodies, scrambles their heads and links their pain.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.0.desc: Aimed diamond seal: your purple spirit flies slow and straight (it can be dodged). If it gets in, your body drops and you control the enemy for 4 s. Missed: the spirit returns and you're dizzy for 1 s. Press again: Release, it hurts itself before you return.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.1.desc: A purple wave from your forehead (an 8-block cone): whoever is caught gets their head scrambled and attacks whoever is closest for 4 s (1 s on a boss).
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.2.desc: Purple threads tie the minds of up to 3 enemies: for 6 s half the damage one takes runs along the thread to the others. A thread snaps past 12 blocks.
ability.battlegroundsmod.ino.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.rendan_n: Uzumaki Combo: needs a target nearby.
message.battlegroundsmod.naruto.sage_bro: Sage Mode: your meditation was broken!
message.battlegroundsmod.sasuke.nothing_: Sharingan: nobody attacked, nothing to read.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.grab_miss: Sand Hand: it didn't grab anyone.
message.battlegroundsmod.gaara.no_target: Sand Coffin: no target in sight.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.no_ta: Shadow Possession: no target within the shadow's reach.
message.battlegroundsmod.shikamaru.escap: Shadow Possession: the target escaped the shadow.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.wave_miss: Mind Disturbance: nobody was caught by the wave.
message.battlegroundsmod.ino.link_few: Mind Link: needs at least 2 enemies nearby.
power.battlegroundsmod.itadori.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). The strongest body of the SubAlmas: the Divergent Fist, the Black Flash right on time and the Dash that goes through anything. Passive: base punches 15% stronger.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.0.desc: The punch lands light and, a moment later, the delayed cursed energy lands again, much harder: the second impact throws and breaks a guard.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.1.desc: A ring closes on your fist: press again right when it closes (a 2-tick window) and the blow becomes a Black Flash: 2.5x the damage, black lightning. Then you are in the zone for 5 s: the window doubles and you can chain up to 4. Too early or too late: a plain punch.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.2.desc: You guard for 1 s: a blow from the front is caught and answered with a high kick. Nobody struck: the cooldown comes back sooner.
ability.battlegroundsmod.itadori.3.desc: You crouch, the ground cracks, and you run 9 blocks through whatever is in front into a flying knee.
power.battlegroundsmod.choso.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Blood Manipulation: the piercing line, the orbs that guard, the binding and Red Scale.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.0.desc: Hold to compress the blood between your palms (up to 3 s) and let go: a line too fast to see, 25 blocks through everyone. The longer the hold, the harder. Instant under Red Scale.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.1.desc: 5 orbs of blood circle you: each one takes a hit or a shot and bursts. Press again (or after 8 s) and the ones left burst into needles all round.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.2.desc: A rope of blood flies 12 blocks and binds whoever it meets for 2.5 s (no walking, no skills). Press again: you pull them to your feet and slam them down.
ability.battlegroundsmod.choso.3.desc: The blood runs faster: 8 s of 50% stronger punches and speed, Piercing Blood without charging, and right away three punches and an uppercut on whoever is in front.
power.battlegroundsmod.nanami.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). The Ratio Technique: the 7:3 point of anything becomes a critical hit. And after hours, Overtime.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.0.desc: A cut with the wrapped blade marks the target with the lines of the 7:3 point (6 s). Press again: you step in and strike the point: a critical, 3x the damage and 1 s of stun.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.1.desc: You jump and drive your fist into the 7:3 point of the ground: a crater with flying blocks and a shockwave that throws everyone round you.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nanami.3.desc: Only after 1 minute of fighting ("still on the clock" before that). You loosen the tie: 12 s of double strength punches, every hit heavier, critical anywhere, and the first hit cracks the ground.
power.battlegroundsmod.nobara.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). Straw Doll Technique: nails, hammer and the Resonance that hits from afar.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.0.desc: Three nails hammered off your hand fly up to 20 blocks and stay where they stick (in someone or in a wall) for 10 s. Press again (Hairpin): they all burst, a short stun on whoever has one.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.1.desc: You hammer a nail into the straw doll and whoever has your nail in them, or your blood on them, feels it wherever they are (up to 60 blocks): heavy damage and 2 s of stun. It costs a little of your blood too.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.2.desc: A nail hammered straight into whoever is touching you: a push, 1 s of stun, and the nail stays.
ability.battlegroundsmod.nobara.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.todo.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 6 (Continental). Boogie Woogie: one clap and everything swaps places.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.0.desc: A clap and you swap places with whoever you aim at (up to 25 blocks).
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.1.desc: You rip a block out of the ground and throw it over the target; a clap swaps you with the block, and you come down from above with a hammer punch.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.2.desc: You clap without the technique. Mobs fall for it and turn round for 1 s; everyone near is left open: the next hit on them is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.todo.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 7 (City). Cursed Speech: every word strains the throat; past the limit he coughs blood and can not speak for 4 s.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.0.desc: Whoever you look at (15 blocks) freezes for 1.5 s (less on stronger ones and bosses). Strains the throat a little.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.1.desc: An unseen weight comes down on the target: heavy damage and 1 s on the ground. Strains the throat a lot.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.2.desc: Whoever you look at (8 blocks) sleeps 3 s, or until hit; that hit is a critical.
ability.battlegroundsmod.inumaki.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
power.battlegroundsmod.miwa.desc: Jujutsu SubAlma, Tier 8 (Block). New Shadow Style: the draw faster than the eye and the Simple Domain that cuts whoever steps in.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.0.desc: Hold to stay in the stance (the longer, the harder) and let go: the sword is drawn and back in one tick, and the cut appears on whoever is within 3 blocks a moment later.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.1.desc: A circle round you: whoever steps in is cut and thrown out on their own, shots that come in are cut down, and a Domain Expansion has no hold on you inside it. Press again, or step out of it, to undo it.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.2.desc: You cross 6 blocks in an instant through the target; the cut appears a moment later.
ability.battlegroundsmod.miwa.3.desc: Still being made in the Skill Visualizer.
message.battlegroundsmod.itadori.miss: Nobody in reach of the blow.
